A '''Gank''' was among the minions of [[Smada]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]], a [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[D'vouran]]. During an outdoor confrontation with the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Youngling/Legends|children]] [[Tash Arranda/Legends|Tash]] and [[Zak Arranda/Legends|Zak Arranda]] in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], Smada ordered the Gank to attack the children, but doing so caused the [[Gank/Legends|Gank]] to be swallowed alive by the planet D'vouran itself.
